caption:
An AI front desk should never play doctor.

When a message sounds urgent (chest pain, breathing trouble, heavy bleeding), this n8n workflow skips the normal reply: staff get an alert email with the phone number, and the patient is told to call 999. No diagnosis, no booking link.

Real n8n run on a demo clinic site; both emails were really sent. The AI's urgent classification is simulated (labelled).
